title: Vendor Production Note: Production-Length Bonus on Ridgeline Special Order Services Delay Credits
content:
A long vendor production run on a delayed Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent earns a production bonus on the delay credit.

**Clause.** The production bonus depends on the calendar days from the date production started to the shipped date: more than 60 days gives a production bonus of 1; more than 30 days and not more than 60 days gives 0.5; otherwise it is 0.

The production bonus is a number of percentage points added to the percentage of the credit base at which the delay credit is figured.

## Day bands

| Calendar days from production start to shipment | Production bonus (points) |
|---|---|
| 61 or more | 1 |
| 31 to 60 | 0.5 |
| 30 or fewer | 0 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical production start 1 March)

| Shipped date | Days | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March | 30 | 0 |
| 1 April | 31 | 0.5 |
| 30 April | 60 | 0.5 |
| 1 May | 61 | 1 |
